text:
sophie (AE): FYI Hearthline sent their SIG XLS. They called out Q2.5 (data classification), Q6.3 (third-party subprocessors), and Q8.1 (incident notification SLA). Need answers + artifacts by Thursday COB. Anyone take owner?

dante (Sales Eng): I can run the Q-by-Q, but need samples for our vendor list and the classification matrix. Do we have a redacted vendor mapping?

leena (Security): I have a redacted `vendor_inventory.csv` and our standard data classification matrix. Note: remove any live emails in the vendor sheet. Typical text for Q6.3: "Redwood maintains an approved vendor inventory; subprocessors are reviewed annually and contracts include SOC2/ISO/processing terms."

mike (CS): Customer also asked whether Dedicated POC will include access to logs for monitoring during the test. We can provide limited, timeboxed access — will need VPC peering + CloudWatch role. I'll prepare a one-page POC access checklist.

dante (Sales Eng): Perfect. Links I'll reference in the XLS: internal playbook `https://redwood.company/playbooks/sig-responses` and artifact bucket `s3://redwood-evidence/hearthline/sig/`

leena (Security): Uploading: `data_classification_matrix_v1.pdf` and `vendor_inventory_redacted.csv` to that bucket now. For Q2.5 include this sentence: "Data is classified at ingestion by product owners; PII is tagged and encrypted at rest using KMS."

mike (CS): For Q8.1 (incident notification) add our standard SLA blurb: "Security incidents impacting confidentiality or availability are notified to customers within 24 hours of detection for severity 1/2 per contract; post-incident report within 7 business days."

sophie (AE): Great. Who will convert to the customer's XLS format? They prefer row comments + attachments per question.

dante (Sales Eng): I'll convert and attach the artifact links. Will keep answers concise (1-2 sentences) and link to artifacts. I'll tag Leena for security phrasing.

leena (Security): Quick note: for vendor CSV, mask vendor IDs and remove any contract values. Also add this proof line for Q6.3: `Vendor review cadence: annual (vendor-reviewer v2.0) -> artifacts at s3://redwood-evidence/vendor-reviews/2025/`

dante (Sales Eng): Draft uploaded to `s3://redwood-evidence/hearthline/sig/drafts/q_by_q.md`. Please review before I generate the XLS.

mike (CS): For POC scheduling, customer suggested Wed next week. I can provision Wed 10am-2pm PT if that works. Need final confirmation before I open firewall windows.

sigbot: Reminder: SIG due Thursday COB for Hearthline. See https://redwood.company/ops/sig-deadlines

sophie (AE): Confirmed contact: jason.t@hearthline.com. I'll tell them Wed POC is fine but will wait for Dante's final XLS.

dante (Sales Eng): Will finish and ping here tonight. Leena please give final redaction sign-off when you can. :thumbsup:

leena (Security): Will review and sign off by EOD today. One more micro-ask: for Q2.5 include retention windows: "PII retained 1 year unless otherwise contracted; logs retained 13 months."

dante (Sales Eng): Noted. I'll include retention lines and the vendor review proof. Closing owners: Dante = XLS & narrative, Leena = security sign-off/redaction, Mike = POC provisioning, Sophie = customer comms.

sophie (AE): Thanks all. I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Dante posts the XLS.

dante (Sales Eng): Posted final XLS + evidence zip to `s3://redwood-evidence/hearthline/sig/final/`. Pinged the customer. Closing thread unless any edits.

leena (Security): Quick QA done: redactions ok. Approved to share.

mike (CS): POC window scheduled Wed 10-2 PT. I've opened peering request and will send IAM role instructions to Jason.

sophie (AE): Customer replied: thanks, got it. :party_parrot:

dante (Sales Eng): Nice. Marking this resolved.
